sections.heading: Repairoperator
sections.content: The Repair operator allows you to repair various particle properties.

sections.heading: Implicit normals
sections.content: Flip implicit normals: when selected, the order of all face vertices will be reversed, which will effectively flip all non-explicit mesh normals.

sections.heading: Explicit normals
sections.content:
Flip explicit normals: when selected, any assigned explicit vertex normals will be flipped.Remove explicit normals: when selected, any assigned explicit vertex normals will be removed.

Flip explicit normals: when selected, any assigned explicit vertex normals will be flipped.

Remove explicit normals: when selected, any assigned explicit vertex normals will be removed.

sections.heading: Transforms
sections.content:
Reset particle transforms: when enabled, all affected particles will have their transform reset to an identity matrix (with their original position and relative shape mesh scale/orientation preserved).

Resetting the transforms of particles will un-instance their meshes (beacuse a unique new mesh must be generated for each particle in order for each particle’s mesh to be re-oriented relative to their reset transform).
